direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px header / 52px guide / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; columns 184px rail / minmax(0,1fr) stage / 360px inspector at 1366x768; stage minimum 55vw x 60vh; no page scroll, internal scroll only in inspector and task lists; interactive targets at least 36px; refit tight panels before reducing type
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68), border rgba(197,204,212,.22); primary neon #A8F04A with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text; official logo immutable black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated elsewhere
direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel title, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; enlarge any stage label under 11px to 11px minimum
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change, then static; no loops or pulses; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; 2px neon focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second and final logo placement; step rail from one steps array with aria-current, arrow-key movement and 36-40px targets; guide strip 52px with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic factory stage SVG; inspector 360px keeping pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, with separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, guide, SVG nodes, inspector and action bar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap; bidirectional SVG-to-inspector highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Enlarge inspector evidence cards: raise body to 13/19 and keep the full source field visible without the bottom card being clipped at 768px height.
Add a visible 2px neon focus ring to Inspect source evidence and move its label into the action-bar primary so header, stage and inspector share one next action.
Strengthen the DOES NOT MATCH callout with a bracket spanning the 120-to-80 gap and an 11px label linked to both tracks.
Keep Route Health Pre-flight and Investigation Source Evidence as separate headed regions with independent status lines; do not merge their controls or completion state.
Give the route select a 40px target, explicit label and focus ring; state Sample offline in the select helper and reserve live-route wording for after selection.
Dim the three option chips on the stage until investigation returns, so Run Sample investigation reads as the sole primary action.
Keep the typed consent form tied to the selected substitute path: show plan name, 35h and $3,115.00 directly above the APPROVE field and retain the 0/27 counter.
Add focus ring and aria-describedby to the phrase input linking the exact phrase, character count and disabled Accept reason.
Enlarge the unselected Select this path targets to 36px and align finish and incremental columns across all three option cards.
Remove the duplicate primary: keep Approve Britt's proposal only in the action bar and make the inspector button a secondary Review tasks control.
Make tasks 1, 2 and 3 a labelled tablist with 40px targets, arrow-key movement and the active task name announced beside UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL.
Compress the proposal intro so all three task summaries fit inside the inspector scroll area without hiding End of proposal at 1366x768.
Clarify the preview state: label CELL-MILL-2 as PREVIEW WILL GO OFFLINE in silver hatch until Apply second shock, reserving stoppedRed for the applied stopped state.
Give the machine select a 40px target, focus ring and helper stating selection previews only and Apply performs the invalidation.
Move Start a fresh scenario into a low-emphasis admin row separated from the shock decision to prevent accidental activation.
Preserve stoppedRed only on CELL-MILL-2 STOPPED outline, hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text; check the Receiving HOLD marker so it does not borrow the same red treatment.
Keep pre-flight nonce and identity status separate from the Investigation not run panel, each with its own heading, status icon and next control.
Add text plus hatch to the constrained Split chip on the stage and mirror that exact state in the legend for non-colour reading.
Keep the revised typed consent visible with the selected path: show Use verified substitute, 35h, $3,115.00 and Scenario changed directly above the phrase field.
Make the constrained Split card fully legible: retain hatch, cross marker and Split requires at least two online compatible cells at 11px minimum.
Add focus ring to the phrase input and tie Accept revised decision disabled state to the 0/27 helper through aria-describedby.
Fix inspector clipping: let the blocked-prior list and proposed-replacement panel scroll independently so task t1 owner and due line are never struck through or cut off.
Label the two groups explicitly as 3 BLOCKED prior tasks and 3 PROPOSED replacements untracked until approval, keeping the approved revised plan status in the action bar.
Remove the duplicate primary by keeping Approve revised tasks in the action bar and demoting the inspector approve button to secondary styling.
Sequence the proof controls visibly as 1 Verify ledger, 2 Seal encrypted packet, 3 Retain independent checkpoint, with each disabled reason stated before the passphrase field.
Give the separate export passphrase input a focus ring, character guidance and an error slot that does not shift the 768px layout.
Reduce stage duplication: keep 70, 35h and 48h only in the Before-After inspector header and let the SVG show route state.
Add a final primary action such as Lock recovery room or Export sealed packet in the action bar; the sealed status sentence alone should not be the endpoint.
Mark all three proof rows Complete with check, text and current ledger label, and make each row focusable for keyboard review.
Keep CELL-MILL-2 offline retained in both the SVG red stopped state and the closing status line so the exception remains auditable.
